description: Na₃BBiPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.85 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.59 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.34-1.43 Å. Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.59 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent BiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-68°. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and three longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one B, and one Bi atom to form distorted ONa₃BiB trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂BiP tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃BiB trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃BiB trigonal bipyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one B, and one Bi atom to form distorted ONa₃BiB trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂BiP tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃BiB trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃BiB trigonal bipyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Bi, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Bi, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂BiP tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Bi, and one P atom.
